item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Gently baked salmon fillet served with a classic, creamy beurre blanc finished with fresh herbs. Served with buttered potatoes and steamed asparagus. (3+6) GREEN DISH: Dish Gratinated portobello served with a classic, creamy beurre blanc finished with fresh herbs. Served with buttered potatoes and steamed asparagus. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Beef bulgogi (Korean BBQ): flash-fried, thinly sliced beef marinated in a traditional sweet-salty sauce with soy, garlic, ginger and sesame oil. Served with steamed rice and spring onion. (1+7+8) GREEN DISH: Dish Bulgogi of flash-fried, thinly sliced celeriac marinated in a traditional sweet-salty sauce with soy, garlic, ginger and sesame oil. Served with steamed rice and spring onion. (1+7+8+10)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Salt-cured turkey with horseradish sauce, creamed kale and browned potatoes. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Glazed butternut squash with creamed kale and browned potatoes. (6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Char siu BBQ pork collar in a delicious marinade, served with rice, roasted broccoli and pak choi. (3+7+8+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Char siu tofu in a delicious marinade, served with rice, roasted broccoli and pak choi. (3+7+8+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Pork patty with creamed vegetables and white potatoes, topped with parsley. Served with lemon and a green salad. (1+2+6) GREEN DISH: Dish Vegetable patties with creamed vegetables and white potatoes, topped with parsley. Served with lemon and a green salad. (1+2+6)
